Le chronomètre, les minuteurs, le Pomodo: The stopwatch, the timers, the Pomodoro and the countdowns.
Tout ce qui compte le temps, au même end: Everything that counts time, in one place: a stopwatch to the hundredth with laps (best and worst in colour), as many timers as you like at once with an alarm, an adjustable Pomodoro (work, short and long breaks) and countdowns to your important dates. Times stay right even if you close NeoDex in between. Chronobox takes over everything from Timer: timers are set in hours, minutes and seconds (up to 99 h), with new presets (25 min, 45 min, 2 h).
